about.description: International Stable Currency offers a stablecoin backed by real-world assets and Treasury securities, combining yield generation with price stability. It enables institutional-grade stable settlement with underlying RWA collateral.
about.registryInfo: International Stable Currency (ISC) is presented as a decentralized protocol, published docs describe key entities such as the ISC Foundation and ISC Reserves, but no public LEI/CIK or regulated issuer entity is identified in public materials.
